title: Page: from 20 s, p99 jumps from about 80 ms to about 450 ms. No failures.
explain: The API Server stops for 400 ms every 2 s (a stop-the-world GC). While paused it does no work, and requests that arrive then wait for the pause to end: p50 hardly changes, but p99 jumps to about 400 ms or more. The average utilisation stays low, so averages do not show it.
hint: Turn on hedged requests on load balancer → API (for example 60 ms): a read with no reply after 60 ms is sent again to another instance. Hedge reads only. A write that is sent again can be written twice, so do not use a short timeout with retries here.
